title: With Time Clock off, Technician is grayed out with the Time Clock tooltip
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Start on Settings, Staff.
custom_steps:
1. Open the New Staff Member window.
  2. In Role, pick "Technician".
  3. If Time Clock is on, switch it off.
  4. Hover the Technician toggle.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The New Staff Member window opens.

Step 2:

  • Role shows Technician.

Step 3:

  • Time Clock is off.
  • Technician is off and grayed out.
  • Clicking the Technician toggle does not switch it on.

Step 4:

  • A tooltip shows "Turn on Time Clock first. Only staff who clock in can be technicians."

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 17 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11879 (Story 1, Technician toggle on a staff member)

  • S1-R4: “Technician can only be on while Time Clock is on. While Time Clock is off, the Technician toggle is off and grayed out, and hovering it shows "Turn on Time Clock first. Only staff who clock in can be technicians." Turning Time Clock off, in the window or any other way (for example through the Public API), turns Technician off.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Hover the grayed-out Technician toggle while Time Clock is off (S1-R4) | "Turn on Time Clock first. Only staff who clock in can be technicians." | Tooltip while hovering”
  • Key Decisions: “Who is a technician is defined by two things only: the person's Technician toggle and their Time Clock. Technician needs Time Clock: it cannot be on while Time Clock is off.”
  • Story 1, Error Handling: “The window never sends Technician on without Time Clock, or for a staff member on the built-in Office User or Time Clock User role. A request from elsewhere (for example an outside tool) that would switch Technician from off to on in either case is refused with "A technician must have Time Clock on." or "This role can't be a technician." respectively, shown through the existing request error behavior, and nothing is saved. When both apply (Time Clock off and one of those roles), the message is "This role can't be a technician.", both on hover in the window and in the refusal. A request for a staff member whose Technician is already on that turns Time Clock off, or moves them to one of those roles, is not refused: it saves, and Technician turns off (S1-R4, S1-N1).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Technician Toggle" (https://claude.ai/artifact/1fuPz8Y4xTg7Syq1mfmJ9R), version 1793629882-06f7, read 2 Nov 2026: page "3 When Technician can't be turned on", picture "Time Clock off" (This build)

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • tt-p3-01-after-time-clock-off.png

The design's own words:

  • “Technician needs Time Clock. While Time Clock is off, Technician is off and grayed out. Tooltip, verbatim: "Turn on Time Clock first. Only staff who clock in can be technicians."”
  • “Turning Time Clock off turns Technician off. Turning Time Clock back on leaves Technician off; the user turns it on.”
